Therefore lambda_uv=-i(Eu-Ev)-gamma1(|u|+|v|)/2-2 gammaphi Hamming(u,v) with the unique steady zero. For population modes u=v of weight j, decay is j gamma1 with binomial multiplicity. The least coherence decay is alpha=gamma1/2+2gammaphi, realized exactly by 2n ordered vacuum/one-excitation pairs, so all earlier population modes contribute sum_{j<q} C(n,j) where q=alpha/gamma1. If q>1 the population slope (1,0) and first coherence slope (1/2,2) have nonzero determinant; no shorter prefix can depend on both rates. If q<1, 2n equal first coherences are followed by the first population, yielding 2n+1. Tie ratios excluded. On the rate rectangle q<=20.5 the binomial cumulative sum has sharp upper cutoff 20, and gamma1=0.005,gammaphi=0.05 attains it for n>=3; n>=21 yields degree-20 polynomial. With q_n=n/2+z sqrt(n)/2+o(sqrt n), de Moivre-Laplace gives the normal CDF.
